from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentTitleInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted info about one judgment document's title and cause of action."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="Document identifier, e.g. '判决文书1'")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action as stated in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case: 民事, 行政, or 刑事")
    relevant_details: str | None = Field(description="Any additional relevant details about the cause or case")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt anchoring the cause of action")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentTitleInfo]
